extracted.intended_audience: researchers, policymakers, students, and general readers seeking country-level statistics on transportation infrastructure and illicit drug activity
extracted.subtask_description: Tabulated country-by-country factual data on road network lengths (total, paved, unpaved, expressways) and narrative country profiles summarizing illicit drug production, transit, consumption, and money-laundering vulnerabilities. Useful for comparative research, reporting, and policy analysis.
